conf.description: insider-threat-uam, console-audit, syslog-cef: header-only parse of the ITM ArcSight CEF export for the 500-series audit data types. The work order ships fields:[] for this block because ObserveIT does not publicly document the per-cs*Label body assignment for audit records, and the operator/subject pairing must never be guessed - so this pipeline extracts only the CEF header plus the near-universal rt/externalId extensions, and carries the entire unresolved body as one opaque custom field pending a live sample.

conf.comment: insider-threat-uam / console-audit / syslog-cef. HEADER-ONLY parse - body (operator, subject, action, second approver, case id) rides undocumented cs*Label slots that cannot be resolved without a live sample. Do not guess the operator/subject split here.

functions.description: parse the fixed-position CEF header; body captured whole as the extension blob
rt is a near-universal CEF timestamp extension; attempt it even though the rest of the body is undocumented
externalId is a near-universal CEF record-id extension; attempt it even though the rest of the body is undocumented
batch rename the confirmed header fields only
event time from rt if present; never target @timestamp directly

carry the entire unresolved CEF body opaquely under a custom field rather than guessing which cs slot is operator, subject, action, second_approver or case_id; this pipeline must be revised once a live sample resolves the cs*Label assignment - see README gap
